verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions security alerts (e.g., code-scanning or dependency alerts) being ingested, validated, or remediated with an auto-opened pull request. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: PR code review comments, /readiness-fix for readiness criteria, Jira/Linear issue delegation, and droid exec as a CI building block. None of these documents a security-alert remediation workflow.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
